_about: Compatibility matrix for SOTA libraries used by sol-baseline. Each entry documents the dtype, shape, GPU SM, and tolerance constraints learned by hands-on use during Contest baseline development. Use this BEFORE writing a new wrapper to avoid library-mismatch RUNTIME_ERROR.

norm.rmsnorm.notes: For per-head norm, reshape Q/K (B, S, n_heads, head_dim) to (B*S*n_heads, head_dim) first.

norm.fused_add_rmsnorm.notes: In-place — call rmsnorm(residual+input) instead when you need a pure-function semantics.

activation.silu_and_mul.input_shape: (M, 2*hidden_size) — 2D contiguous; 3D input dispatches FAIL with 'Check failed: (false) is false' on SM100
activation.silu_and_mul.notes: Wrap with x.reshape(-1, 2*inter).contiguous() before calling, then .view(b, s, inter) after.

gemm.gemm_fp8_nt_groupwise.purpose: DeepSeek-V3 / Qwen3-VL FP8 path (BlockWise1x128 act / BlockWise128x128 weight)
gemm.gemm_fp8_nt_groupwise.scale_granularity_mnk: (1, 128, 128) is the only DS recipe; other granularities exist for other recipes

scale_layout_MN.notes: Both must be .t().contiguous() from natural (M, K/128) / (N/128, K/128) compute order.

gemm.gemm_fp8_nt_groupwise.wrong_alternative: gemm.gemm_fp8_nt_blockscaled hardcodes (128,128,128) granularity — DOES NOT support DeepSeek's 1x128 act recipe.

gemm.mm_M1_16_K7168_N256.purpose: DeepSeek-V3 router gemm (specialized for routing GEMM shape)
gemm.mm_M1_16_K7168_N256.warning: fp16 inputs require cast to bf16; on small-M the cast + persistent-launch warmup beats cuBLAS only if you skip the cast. Not worth using when input is already fp16.

fused_moe.trtllm_fp8_block_scale_moe.status: BROKEN on B200 (SM100) in 0.6.12 — autotunes or hits unimplemented sm_100 path; calls do not return.
fused_moe.trtllm_fp8_block_scale_moe.tried: Contest/FIB/020 (DeepSeekV3 routing, E=256 top-8). Hung >3 min on synthetic 128-token input.
fused_moe.trtllm_fp8_block_scale_moe.alternative: Use sort+per-expert torch.mm or wait for FlashInfer update / DeepEP.

fused_moe.cutlass_fused_moe.status: BROKEN on B200 (SM100) bf16 path — same hang as trtllm_fp8_block_scale_moe.
fused_moe.cutlass_fused_moe.tried: Contest/L1/044 (DeepSeek-V3 bf16, E=256 top-8). Hung >5 min.

mla.BatchMLAPagedAttentionWrapper.lse_convention: base-2 by default (matches FIB reference's `logsumexp / log(2)`). Use return_lse_base_on_e=True for ln.

BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper.lse_convention: base-2 by default — do NOT divide by log(2) again.

BatchPrefillWithRaggedKVCacheWrapper.plan_args: qo_indptr, kv_indptr, num_qo_heads, num_kv_heads, head_dim_qk, head_dim_vo, causal, sm_scale

env_vars.FLASHINFER_TRACE_DIR: Required when running FIB benchmarks; points to the unpacked flashinfer-trace blob directory (e.g. data/flashinfer-trace). Without this, kv_indptr/kv_indices safetensors don't resolve.

flash_attn_func.input_shape: q: (B, S, Hq, D); k/v: (B, S, Hkv, D) — native GQA via asymmetric head counts (no expand needed)
flash_attn_func.notes: For fp32 attention, fall back to F.scaled_dot_product_attention (cuDNN backend).

geglu / swiglu.notes: Liger 0.8 LigerRMSNorm/LigerSiLUMulFunction has PyTorch 2.9 .distributed.tensor compat issue — use FlashInfer rmsnorm / direct swiglu_forward instead.

F.scaled_dot_product_attention.fp32_path: cuDNN backend — the ONLY SDPA option for fp32; matches reference's manual matmul-softmax-matmul
F.scaled_dot_product_attention.notes: enable_gqa=True is essential for asymmetric head counts. Combine attn_mask + enable_gqa for varlen vision attention.

F.rms_norm.notes: On B200, F.rms_norm + cuDNN backend matches FlashInfer rmsnorm performance for fp32 (no speedup), so prefer it for fp32 paths.

decision_matrix._format: When you need X, use Y (constraints).
decision_matrix.Q/K full-dim RMSNorm: flashinfer.rmsnorm with x.reshape(-1, n_heads * head_dim) BEFORE reshape-to-heads
decision_matrix.SwiGLU activation bf16: torch.cat([gate, up], dim=-1).reshape(-1, 2*inter).contiguous() -> flashinfer.activation.silu_and_mul -> .view(b, s, inter)
decision_matrix.MLA paged prefill bf16: Same wrapper with causal=True and qo_indptr from input
decision_matrix.Sparse MoE bf16 expert forward: sort-by-expert + per-expert torch.mm (FlashInfer cutlass_fused_moe broken on B200)
decision_matrix.FP8 MoE: Not viable on B200 with FlashInfer 0.6.12; wait for newer release or use DeepEP

anti_patterns.data_ptr_caching: NEVER key cached quant outputs on tensor.data_ptr() — PyTorch allocator reuses addresses across eval calls, causing stale fp8 buffers to leak. Always re-quantize per call or key on (shape, dtype, device).
anti_patterns.fused_add_rmsnorm_inplace: flashinfer.fused_add_rmsnorm mutates BOTH input and residual in-place. Either clone first or use rmsnorm(residual+x) when you need pure-function semantics.
anti_patterns.silu_and_mul_3d: FlashInfer activation kernels DO NOT accept 3D input despite the docstring claim. Always reshape to 2D first.
anti_patterns.fa2_fp32: flash_attn_func requires bf16/fp16 — fp32 inputs error with 'FlashAttention only support fp16 and bf16 data type'. Use F.sdpa fallback.
anti_patterns.fp32_decoder_optimization: fp32 transformer decoder blocks are already SOTA via F.rms_norm + cuDNN SDPA + F.silu codegen; expect ~1.00x. Skip.
anti_patterns.tolist_in_loops: x.tolist() forces full CPU-GPU sync. In RoPE / index-building loops, use torch.cat(list_of_gpu_tensors) instead — 3x faster.
anti_patterns.broadcast_matmul_memory_illusion: (1,T,H) @ (E,H,D) broadcast matmul does NOT save replication memory — cuBLAS materializes the broadcast internally. Use the explicit replicated form for clarity.
